name: FREE Reseller Profit-After-Fees Calculator 2026 — eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Facebook Marketplace (Excel / Google Sheets)
summary: Type an item once and see your profit and ROI on every marketplace side by side, with the fee rates dated so you know which ones were actually checked.
description_html:
Free calculator: type an item's cost, price and shipping once and see the fee, your payout, your profit and your ROI on eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop and Facebook Marketplace side by side — and which one pays most.

Why side by side matters

On the sheet's own example — a $12 item listed at $45, $6.50 to ship — the gap between the best marketplace and the worst is $7.07 of profit on one item. Most fee calculators price one platform at a time, so you never see that number.

What's in it

  • Calculator — one item, six marketplaces at once, with the best one named for you. A row turns red when you would lose money.
  • Batch — 20 items at a time, marketplace picked per row from a dropdown.
  • Fees — every rate editable, and each row carries the date it was last checked.

The fee maths is the real work

  • eBay's 13.6% is charged on the total including buyer-paid shipping, and the per-order fee drops from $0.40 to $0.30 on orders of $10 or less. Both are modelled.
  • Poshmark is a flat $2.95 under $15 and 20% at or above it — a cliff that flat-percentage calculators get wrong.
  • Mercari's 10% covers item plus buyer-paid shipping; the old 2.9% + $0.50 seller processing fee was removed in January 2025.
  • Facebook Marketplace's roughly 5% has a minimum around $0.40, which bites on cheap items.

Honest about what isn't verified. eBay, Poshmark and Mercari were checked on 10 September 2026. Depop and Facebook Marketplace say "not re-verified" in red on the Fees sheet, because they were not. You can fix either in one cell.

Excel 2016+ and Google Sheets (File → Import). No macros, no email required, no upsell wall — the whole thing works the moment you open it.

If it saves you a bad listing decision, a rating on this page is what lets anyone else find it. The full Reseller Inventory & Profit Tracker 2026 ($19) is the same maths across a whole business: 500 inventory items with auto SKUs, fees and ROI on every sale, a death-pile report for stale listings, sell-through and best-platform dashboards, and a Schedule-C-style tax summary.

There is also a free write-up of what each marketplace actually takes in 2026 — the rates, what each one charges against, and the four things that catch resellers out. Same numbers as this sheet, in plain English.

Not tax or financial advice. Fee rates are editable approximations — verify them for your own account before pricing on them.
